title: Clear-end action
statement: For a register index $r$ among $m$ work tapes, states $c_E$ and $n_{ext}$, and an optional Boolean value $r_d$, define an action as follows: if $r_d$ is present, write the blank symbol on tape $r$, move its head one cell to the left, and enter state $c_E$; if $r_d$ is absent, leave the work tape unchanged, move its head one cell to the right, and enter state $n_{ext}$. The other action components are those specified by the register-action construction.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ is an index among the $m$ work tapes
caveat: The referenced register-action construction is not included among the supplied definitions, so the full action components cannot be stated precisely.
